title: Research On The Demon King
paragraphs: “Huh!? Me again!?”
Itsuki looked utterly dumbfounded. Well, yes, that seems to be the case. According to Lady Filo, that’s exactly what happened.
“I heard that the crimson swine and the Smoked one were the masterminds, using Itsuki as a test subject for their experiments.”
“…That princess again?”
“What is wrong with that woman!? Is she the final boss or something!?”
“Wait, who the hell is ‘Smoked’?”
“The one in flashy armor who eventually became Itsuki’s companion.”
“Oh, that guy. My former comrade… But why ‘Smoked’?”
The time has finally come to tell this tale. Let me recount the pitiful end of that man.
“He was called ‘Smoked’ because, when he was executed, he was quite literally turned into smoked meat.”
Father and the others were left speechless.
Strange. I thought this was the part where they should laugh.
“I… I don’t even know what to say.”
“Same here. Actually, I don’t want to know.”
“The only silver lining here is that you’re terrible at explaining things.”

They were discussing it with pale faces. Éclair, on the other hand, seemed to understand who we were talking about and stared off into the distance. I suppose they were comrades in arms, after all. Eventually, Father spoke, as if trying to change the subject.
“Uh… okay, hold on. Let’s get back on track—this conversation is going off the rails.”
Father pressed his fingers against his temple, deep in thought.
“Could it be that this Demon King… was originally a Hero? Maybe they lost control because of a cursed weapon?”
“I see. So, as a responsibility for that, other Heroes were summoned to stop them.”
“I would never do something like that!”
“The first world was in a pretty messed-up state. Itsuki probably just lost his way.”
“By the way, what were the people under that mind control like?”
I searched my memories, recalling that time. Back in Melromarc’s capital, they had been frantically trying to tear down the castle gates.
“They kept chanting ‘justice, justice,’ attacking while endlessly pointing out others’ flaws—completely ignoring their own.”
“That sounds incredibly annoying…”
“Like those looting terrorists in foreign countries?”
“Going by what we’ve heard, it does seem likely that weapon had mind control properties.”
“And I was the main perpetrator… or rather, the one being used. That pretty much makes me the Demon King, doesn’t it?”
“How was it resolved in the end?”
“I took down the ones rampaging through the city, while Naofumi and the others defeated both the mastermind and Itsuki, capturing them together.”
“…So I was almost executed, huh?”
“You were only being manipulated, and thanks to the curse’s aftereffects, you were left in a dazed state, living in a village. After that, you ended up working under Naofumi, as far as I recall.”
No doubt about it. He was always spacing out, with that stalker pig hanging around him. Itsuki tilted his head in confusion.
“I know I’m the one saying this, but… that punishment seems pretty lenient.”
“Yeah… Maybe there was some reason for it? Motoyasu-kun, do you know anything?”
“I don’t really remember.”

I do remember that there was some reason behind it, but Father and the others never properly explained it to me. However, at the time, I was more focused on fighting wholeheartedly for world peace, so I didn’t find much meaning in questioning it. After that incident, all I did was level up with Lady Filo. Ah, right, before that, I sent the crimson swine to Faubrey.
“Hmm… Maybe the condition for Motoyasu looping is tied to our deaths?”
“What do you mean?”
“Perhaps if the Four Holy Heroes die, it causes something bad for the future Naofumi and the others.”
“Either way, it looks like the future me managed to avoid the worst-case scenario.”
“We can assume that Naofumi was keeping an eye on him and allowed him to be dealt with accordingly.”
As we talked, Éclair nodded.
“I see. If that’s true, we might be able to deliver a devastating blow to the Three Heroes Church. Kitamura-dono, do you remember the facility where the future Kawasumi-dono was held?”
“Of course. It was the place Lady Filo raided under Naofumi’s orders to seize supplies. I was there as well.”

That was the time we confiscated research equipment and hoarded resources. It was like… a hidden fortress of some kind. Though, I don’t know much beyond that. Father had ordered me to take the crimson swine to Faubrey right after.
“If it turns out they were researching the Demon King in the past… that would be undeniable proof. If we inform the Queen, she’ll know how to handle this.”
“That’s assuming the Queen is willing to cooperate.”
At those words, the atmosphere grew heavy. Outside, Yuki-chan and the others were playing cheerfully—completely opposite to the tension here.
“In the end, we did massacre both her husband and daughter.”

“N-No! We mustn’t give up! The Queen is a wise woman. She should understand that the true blame lies with King Aultcray and Princess Malty. At the very least, with this information, she could frame the Three Heroes Church as the real masterminds and position Melromarc as a victim as well!”
Éclair spoke as if trying to convince himself. Well, knowing that Queen, she probably would handle things well. And if she lost her mind and attacked us, we’d simply fight back.
“Either way, we should focus on leaving Siltvelt first.”
“Naofumi-san is right. The only way to avoid being used is to see the world for ourselves and determine what is truly right and wrong.”
“The so-called victims might even come begging us to repel an invasion from a neighboring country.”
“That’s true. Fortunately, right now, we’re only being treated as adventurers. We should act as discreetly as possible and keep the fact that we’re Heroes a secret.”
“We should also avoid changing our weapons in front of people or absorbing materials into them.”
“Even though we did that all over Siltvelt’s capital, didn’t we?”
“We’ll have to be more careful from now on.”

And so, as we discussed our next moves, we finally arrived at the border of Siltvelt. This was the complete opposite of the journey we took last time. We were able to pass through the border much more easily than expected. By having an adventurer—whom Father met in a town near the border—ride with us, we were able to pass through without issue. Or rather, it would be more accurate to call them a collaborator disguised as an adventurer. It seems that Father and Éclair were aware of this.
“We managed to leave Siltvelt.”
“Worst case scenario, we could’ve just abandoned the carriage and had Motoyasu force his way across the border. Then we’d just hide our presence and teleport everyone using Portal.”
“We should get a travel permit somewhere. Luckily, we’re no longer in Siltvelt. It would be best to find an envoy from Faubrey and obtain one.”
“Speaking of which, while many countries seem to have sent envoys, Faubrey’s representative hasn’t arrived yet.”
“Faubrey is slow to act. However, they should be arriving around this time. Worst case, if we contact the guild, they can issue the permit on the same day.”
“Ah… I actually thought we’d end up sneaking in illegally and leaving it to Motoyasu, as per Naofumi-san’s plan.”
“I was expecting us to wait for an envoy, but thanks to Iwatani-dono, things went smoothly.”
“They wanted to talk to us too. After listening for a bit, it became clear what they were after.”
As expected of Father. He’s becoming more and more knowledgeable about the workings of this world.
“It was probably difficult for them to grant us passage while we were still in Siltvelt. That adventurer also suggested getting the permit from the guild.”

Various schemes and interests are at play here. For now, I’ll make sure to remember this. If I go through another loop, I should obtain a travel permit on the very first day of my adventure. I can probably manage it if I show my spear. Though I really shouldn’t be thinking about the next loop, it’s always good to be prepared. And so, we continued progressing smoothly through the small country serving as our detour. At the guild, we declared ourselves as Heroes and received a travel permit on the same day.
It’s safe to assume that our faces are now recognized, isn’t it?
“By the way, shouldn’t we be worried about the Waves?”
“They’re supposed to happen in about a month, right?”
The issue of the Waves had nearly slipped our minds. Of course, we would have to participate eventually.
“Hourglasses exist all over the world. It’s probably happening somewhere as we speak.”
“Will everything be okay?”
“Apparently, the Seven Star Heroes and Lady Filo’s group are taking care of it.”
At least, that’s what I heard in the first world. The great Lady Filo is secretly fighting against the Waves.
“So as the Four Holy Heroes, we should head to Faubrey first and properly accept our mission, huh?”
“Yeah. Since we were summoned improperly, we should go to a country that can manage us correctly.”
“Faubrey is a major power, and from what Motoyasu says, it has some shady aspects, but at least it won’t exploit us for evil purposes due to international scrutiny… probably?”
“I asked the previous Naofumi about that. As long as we play our cards right, we won’t be used unnecessarily.”
“I see.”
“Éclair, do you know anything about Faubrey?”
“Faubrey? That country has historically integrated summoned Heroes into its bloodline. It’s essentially the representative nation of this world.”
Éclair began explaining Faubrey’s history. I’ve been there before. The roads were paved. How should I put it…
Even back in the game, it was known as a well-developed country.
“It’s a nation at the forefront of technology and deeply devoted to the Heroes. Unlike the Three Heroes Church, they don’t discriminate against specific Heroes.”
“Ren, Itsuki, does this country match what you remember from the game?”
“Is it okay to rely on our game knowledge?”
“For the most part, your knowledge should be accurate, so don’t worry.”
“Then it must be quite an advanced nation. It seems trustworthy.”
“Though in quests, you often get dragged into political conflicts.”
“Yeah, that’s true.”
“Well, that’s just part of the experience. The game had to keep players entertained, after all.”
Ren and Itsuki were reviewing what they remembered about Faubrey from the game. How nostalgic. I used to be hooked on online games back then, and these memories bring back those fun times.
